title: What Have You Done to Solange?
writer: Bruno Di Geronimo, Massimo Dallamano, Peter M. Thouet
actors: Fabio Testi, Karin Baal, Cristina Galbó
plot: A teacher who is having an affair with one of his students is reluctant to present an alibi when his lover witnesses the first in a series of murders connected to their school.
